claim: Clay Pit workers start their shift a tenth of a day later than the standard workplace shift and finish a tenth of a day later; the shift is the same length (60% of the day).

evidence.reference: WorkplaceConfig.WorkTimeRange. Clay Pit stores 0 → 0.6; 53 workplaces including Farm and Bakery store the standard 0.9 → 0.5 (wrapping past 1.0). Foresters' Hub, Orchard and Quarry store 0 → 0.5 (same late start, standard finish); Cheesery, Chicken Coop, Fondue Bar and Roadworks Office store 0.95 → 0.55.

notes: Community reports that clay workers are late risers match the stored schedule. The clock mapping of fraction 0 is unresolved, so the offset is one tenth of a day rather than a number of hours, and whether the crew also sleeps longer is tracked separately in clay-pit-late-start.
